title: Sliding Window Check
description: Fixed windows, incremental updates, and max sums.

questions.prompt: For `[2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2]` and `k = 3`, the max window sum is:
Updating a fixed window by adding `arr[i]` and subtracting `arr[i-k]` keeps time at:
questions.explanation: Each element enters and leaves once → linear pass after the first window.

questions.prompt: If `n < k` for a fixed window of size `k`:

options.text: There is no valid window of size `k`

questions.explanation: A contiguous window of length `k` cannot exist when the array is shorter than `k`.

questions.prompt: Sliding window applies only when the array is sorted.

options.text: False — contiguous order matters, not sorted order

questions.explanation: Windows track contiguous index ranges. Sortedness is a two-pointers concern, not a window requirement.
